title: Double Drip Blueberry Sour Raspberry 100ml Shortfill
description: Double Drip’s Blueberry Sour Raspberry brings a juicy jolt of sour berry goodness, with a subtle icy finish that makes it as refreshing as it is delicious. Think rich, juicy blueberries bursting over vibrant, tangy plump raspberries – then add a candy kick of sugary sourness for an irresistible sweet edge. Blueberry Sour Raspberry is fiendishly fruity and devilishly delightful, with a depth of flavour that grabs your tastebuds and never lets go. If you love bold berry flavours with an edgy sour note, then look no further than this true blue sensation. Long-lasting 100ml shortfill bottles from Double Drip offer the ideal way to personalize your favourite e-liquid flavours by adding nicotine to your exact preference. Each bottle comes with 100ml of nicotine-free e-liquid and an additional 20ml of space for two nicotine shots , giving you complete control over your vaping experience. To create 120ml of 3mg e-liquid, simply add 2 x 10ml 18mg nicotine shots to a 100ml shortfill, give it a good shake, and voila, you have your perfect mix. Alternatively, leave out the nicotine entirely and simply enjoy the pure, delicious flavour and rich, billowing sub-ohm clouds. Shortfills not only offer extended longevity from your favourite e-liquid flavours but also serve as more economical and convenient alternative to smaller bottles of high-vg e-liquid. Thanks to their higher VG content, they're the perfect match for high-powered, sub-ohm vape kits and low-resistance coils , ensuring maximum flavour and vapour production from your device. Discover the ultimate vaping experience with Double Drip E-Liquid, a hugely popular and influential vape juice brand proudly made in the UK. With a wide range of e-liquid formulations to suit all e-cigarette setups, Double Drip has an e-juice for every preference. Whether you prefer sub-ohm (high-VG) e-liquid , 50/50 e-liquid , Nicotine Salts , or long-lasting shortfills, Double Drip has you covered. Please note: This shortfill contains a high concentrate of flavour when compared to 50ml Double Drip shortfills
